title: Lens Library
description: Compute HASH values and simulate a lens box arrangement system.
writeup:
## Approach

The HASH algorithm is a simple rolling hash: start at 0, then for each character add its ASCII value, multiply by 17, and take mod 256. This maps any string to a box number 0–255.

## Part 1

Apply HASH to each comma-separated initialization step and sum the results.

## Part 2

Simulate a HASHMAP with 256 boxes, each holding an ordered list of labeled lenses. The label's HASH determines the box. `label=N` inserts or updates a lens with focal length N (preserving slot order). `label-` removes the lens with that label. After processing all steps, compute focusing power: sum `(box + 1) * (slot + 1) * focal_length` across every lens in every box.
